[LCCO.8.3.2] A pattern `<a>.<b>.<c>` matches a code `<x>` iff the
pattern's segments are a prefix of the code's segments at segment
boundaries. `request` matches `request.malformed` and
`request.unsupported`. `request.malformed` matches only
`request.malformed`. `request.malform` does not match
`request.malformed`; matching is at segment boundaries, not
character prefix.
